notes: harness/capability_lint.py: load_sweep/sweep_stale/sweep_hit_under (:303-350) gate _derive_dirs (:432-465) — a dir(X) tag is refused with file:line when the latest read_dir_sweep.json has a hit under X, and lands in unresolved (fail closed) when the sweep is missing or >48h stale. derive()/scan_queue() thread sweep through (:583-628).

harness/read_dir_sweep.py: write_runtime (:131-152) sweeps every allow.read_dirs root, writes runtime/read_dir_sweep.json (masked hits per root + ts), diffs against the previous write; aq_alert (:159-174) aq-adds one row per hit new since the last write. `--write-runtime` CLI flag wired for the timer.
harness/systemd/lumen-read-dir-sweep.timer + .service: daily (05:15 UTC + jitter) oneshot running read_dir_sweep.py --write-runtime, modeled on harness/systemd/lumen-liveness-clear.timer/.service.

Tests: harness/tests/test_capability_allow.py (dir refused on fresh hit, hit outside cited subdir still tags, unresolved on missing/stale sweep, sweep_stale/sweep_hit_under unit tests) and harness/tests/test_read_dir_sweep.py (write_runtime new-hit diffing, idempotent rerun, aq_alert dedup/fail-open).

Regression fix: capability_lint.derive's default sweep=None now fails closed (no runtime file yet in this worktree), which broke 9 pre-existing tests in harness/tests/test_capability_lint.py and 4 in dispatcher/tests/{test_dispatcher,test_runaway}.py that expected dir auto-tagging without a sweep concept. Fixed by giving each a fresh, hitless sweep fixture (matching their existing policy/roster fixture pattern) rather than weakening the gate.
